question: Which hip hop legend's family is now fighting in court over a will?
story: The Notorious B.I.G.'s son says his grandmother's will was rewritten fifteen days before she died. According to TMZ, Christopher Wallace Junior filed court documents this week challenging an amendment to the will of Voletta Wallace, Biggie's mother, who passed away in February of twenty twenty five. Here is what the original reportedly said. A twenty twenty version divided up her furs, her jewelry, Biggie's music awards, a Mercedes SUV, and a property in Jamaica, with most of it going to Christopher and his sister, and her stake in the company running Biggie's estate going to her foundation. The amendment reportedly cut the grandchildren out and handed control to Wayne Barrow, Biggie's former manager. Christopher's filing reportedly argues the signatures look inconsistent, and asks a judge to throw the amendment out and remove Barrow entirely. Barrow won a separate court fight over that same trust earlier this month. This one is still pending.
